findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素揭露：客戶整併在部分情況下已導致需求下降，因客戶取得自製產能（in-house）；未點名最大客戶正在自製或導入第二供應商。
findings.excerpt: In some cases, consolidation among our customers has led to a reduction in demand for our services as customers have acquired the capacity to manufacture products in-house.

findings.claim: 10-K MD&A：公司依賴少數客戶，任一大客戶減單或流失會有重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: Because we depend upon a small number of customers for a significant percentage of our total revenues, a reduction in orders from, a loss of, or any other adverse actions by, any one of these customers would reduce our revenues and could have a material adverse effect on our business, operating results and share price.

findings.claim: 搜尋未找到最大客戶（Nvidia）正導入第二供應商或將Fabrinet環節自製的具名報導或公告；FY2025 10-K 顯示 Nvidia 占 27.6%、Cisco 18.2%。
findings.excerpt: During fiscal year 2025, NVIDIA Corporation and Cisco Systems, Inc. contributed 27.6% and 18.2%, respectively, of our revenues.

note: 無具名的最大客戶第二供應商／自製公告；僅有一般性風險揭露。
